title: Accounting changes and errors — Pemberton Inc.
instructions: Pemberton Inc. is closing its Year 3 books (calendar year). Classify each item, compute the revised depreciation and record the error correction. Ignore income taxes.

exhibits.title: Items
exhibits.content:
1. Changed inventory costing from FIFO to weighted average.
2. Revised a machine's remaining useful life.
3. Changed from straight-line to sum-of-the-years'-digits depreciation.
4. Found that Year 2 depreciation of $40,000 was never recorded.
5. Presented consolidated statements for the first time in place of the separate statements of the parent and its long-held subsidiaries.
6. Switched from cash-basis bookkeeping to GAAP accrual accounting.

exhibits.title: Machine
exhibits.content: Cost **$200,000**; salvage **$20,000**; 10-year straight-line life. At the start of Year 3 (after 2 full years), the remaining life is revised to **5 years** and salvage to **$10,000**.

options: Change in estimate effected by a change in principle

rows.label: Item 1
rows.explanation: Moving between acceptable inventory methods is a principle change, applied retrospectively.

rows.label: Item 2
rows.explanation: Revising useful life is a change in estimate, applied prospectively.

rows.label: Item 3
rows.answer: Change in estimate effected by a change in principle
rows.explanation: A change in depreciation method is handled prospectively.

rows.label: Item 4
rows.explanation: An omitted entry is an error, corrected by restatement.

rows.label: Item 5
rows.explanation: Changing the entities in combined statements changes the reporting entity.

rows.label: Item 6
rows.explanation: Moving from a non-GAAP basis to GAAP corrects an error.

rows.label: Carrying amount at the start of Year 3

parts.prompt: Record the correction of item 4 in Year 3 (Year 2's books are closed).
parts.explanation: Errors in closed periods adjust opening retained earnings, not current expense.
